baseline: 1970–2000 climatological normals (CHELSA 1981–2010 shifted with the game paleoclimate model, see processing.baseline)

sections.name: elev
sections.note: mean land elevation of the cell; open ocean = 0 (sea surface)

landfrac.note: fraction of MAP cells (cells.bin.gz) inside the SIM cell: land = id >= 2, lake = id 1

source.name: CHELSA V2.1 climatologies 1981–2010 (monthly tas, pr; 4′ overview of the 30″ COGs) + ETOPO 2022 v1 60″ surface elevation (sampled every 3′)
citation: Karger, D. N., Conrad, O., Böhner, J., Kawohl, T., Kreft, H., Soria-Auza, R. W., Zimmermann, N. E., Linder, H. P., Kessler, M. (2021). Climatologies at high resolution for the earth’s land surface areas. EnviDat. https://doi.org/10.16904/envidat.228
Karger, D. N. et al. (2017). Climatologies at high resolution for the earth’s land surface areas. Scientific Data 4, 170122. https://doi.org/10.1038/sdata.2017.122
NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. 2022: ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model. https://doi.org/10.25921/fd45-gt74

processing.resample: area-weighted mean of the 4′ CHELSA pixels (7.5 x 7.5 per 0.5° cell, land and sea); a cell has data when the pixels cover >= 0.5 pixel; no data north of 84°N (sea, filled)
processing.elevation: mean of the ETOPO 2022 surface samples (3′, 10 x 10 per cell) on map land (cells.bin.gz id >= 2), floored at -430 m and at 0 m in cells that also hold sea; cells inside big lakes: lowest neighbouring land height; sea: 0
processing.antarctic: no correction: CHELSA annual Dome C -50.7, Vostok -52.4, South Pole -45.7 °C vs observed -54.5, -55.2, -49.4
processing.baseline: CHELSA 1981–2010 -> 1970–2000: T -= mean regionalDT(1981–2010) - mean regionalDT(1970–2000) (0.13..0.67 °C), P /= ratio of mean precipFactor (0.989..1.019); src/sim/climate/paleo.js
processing.oceanFill: only north of 84°N (no CHELSA data): screened Poisson fill from the 84°N edge towards a zonal/seasonal sea-surface air formula with current anomalies; influence length T 3.5 cells, P 5 cells; second temperature pass over frozen seas (ice weight 0..1 for pass-1 T -1..-7 °C): target = min(formula, 25-cell coast extension); enclosed water bodies < 600 cells: Laplace fill from shores
